这个币的名字得解释一下，很多人第一反应是拼错了。mihao 是把"你好"的 ni hao 和猫叫声"喵 miāo"缝在一起的谐音梗。形象是一只长白胡子的橘猫，有点招财猫的感觉，口号是"you met me at a very chinese time in my life"，改自《搏击俱乐部》的台词，配合海外年轻人玩的"Chinamaxxing"文化梗。10 月 25 号在 https://t.co/ozwi6x9g5H 上发射，dev 是 faceofsol，匿名，有多次发射记录。

前两周这个币一直在百万级市值徘徊，社区在慢慢做 PFP 铺垫，换头像、刷时间线，算是在攒有机热度。真正的引爆点是 11 月 10 到 11 号，Ansem 直接把自己的推特头像换成了这只猫，连续发推推广，说它是这个周期的"纯 meme"。结果就是从 1 到 3M 直接拉到 ATH 大概 15M 到 22M。@btc2ai 当时记录的数据是 358 倍。

我的判断：这波的真正发动机就是 Ansem，社区前期的 PFP 铺垫是底子，但没有 Ansem 换头像这一下，它大概率还在百万级趴着。现在的问题是 Ansem 的注意力能留多久。当前市值大概 5M 到 6.5M，从 ATH 下来跌了 70% 到 80%。持仓地址 34K 这个数字很亮眼，说明散户基础不薄。前十大持仓 17% 到 21%，分布还行。流动性数百 K 级，对于这个市值来说中规中矩。

10 月底发射的时候我刷到过，当时觉得又是一个谐音梗币，pass 了。11 月 10 号 Ansem 换头像那天我也看到了，但觉得已经拉起来了不想追。结果后面又从 3M 拉到 20M，真的有点上头。现在回到 5M 附近，说实话这个位置我开始有点想法了，但还在犹豫，后面再看。

$SpaceXCoin $882k MC

What it is: a BSC meme riding the @SpaceX , @elonmusk  and @cz_binance  narrative. No product, no revenue model. The whole bet is attention around one real-world story.

The story is real, and it is big. This week Musk and SpaceX pledged two SpaceX shares to every American child through Trump Accounts, one from the company and one from Musk personally, a gift the press valued near $18 billion. That is the fuel. The community is also tying in CZ and Binance, since @binance  holds SpaceX exposure and the token lives on $BSC. The on-chain detail some are pointing at is wallets that used to trade only on @solana  now showing up here on BSC.

Now the part you have to hear before anything else. This token's ticker, $SPCXB, is the same ticker Binance uses for its real tokenized SpaceX stock ($bStocks), which trades above $100 and has over $130M on-chain. This meme is a 1B-supply coin on $PancakeSwap, not that. The name and ticker overlap is close enough to confuse someone in a hurry, and there is a whole swarm of copycat contracts using SpaceXcoin and 7777 vanity addresses. If you ever go near this, the exact CA is the only thing that matters.

What I like: the narrative is as hot as narratives get right now, volume is real, and celebrity memes can run further than they have any right to while the story is fresh.

What I do not: it is down around 62% on the day off its high, it is pure story with nothing underneath, the ticker collision with a real Binance product smells deliberate, and the copycat swarm makes it a minefield. This is a trade on attention, not an investment, and the attention here is already fading fast.

Real question: does the Musk shares story have enough fuel left to give this another leg, or did the first wave already take the money and leave?

Most real money in memes comes from buying strong projects after people lose patience.

I keep a watchlist of every meme coin that reaches 1M+ market cap.

is the narrative still strong?
is the team still active?
are people still talking about it?

is the chart forming a floor?
